code:
use default

union Request is
    NTH(index: int, even: bool)
    BY_INDEX(first: int, last: int, even: bool)
    BY_VALUE(low: int, high: int, even: bool)
si

union Parsed is
    UNDERSTOOD(request: Request) default
    REJECTED(message: string)
si

sieve(even: bool, limit: int) -> List[int] is
    let start = if even then 2 else 1 fi
    let survivors mut =
        from(start, 2) |> take_while(value => value <= limit) |> collect()

    let position mut = 1

    while position < survivors.count /\
        survivors[position] <= survivors.count do
        let spacing = survivors[position]

        survivors =
            survivors
                |> index()
                |> filter(entry => (entry.index + 1) % spacing != 0)
                |> map(entry => entry.value)
                |> collect()

        position = position + 1
    od

    survivors
si

let lucky_numbers = sieve(false, 150_000)
let even_lucky_numbers = sieve(true, 150_000)

series(even: bool) -> List[int] =>
    if even then even_lucky_numbers else lucky_numbers fi

as_number(text: string) -> int? is
    let negative = text.length > 0 /\ text[0] == '-'
    let digits = if negative then text[1..<0] else text fi

    if digits.length == 0 \/
        !(digits |> all(digit => digit >= '0' /\ digit <= '9')) then
        return null
    fi

    let value = int.parse(digits)

    return if negative then -value else value fi
si

as_kind(text: string) -> bool? =>
    case text.to_lower()
    when "lucky" then false
    when "evenlucky" then true
    else null
    esac

parse(arguments: List[string]) -> Parsed is
    if arguments.count == 0 then
        return Parsed.REJECTED(
            "no arguments: expected j [k] [lucky|evenLucky]")
    fi

    if arguments.count > 3 then
        return Parsed.REJECTED("too many arguments")
    fi

    let trailing = arguments[arguments.count - 1]
    let even mut = false
    let counts mut = arguments

    if !as_number(trailing)? then
        if let kind = as_kind(trailing) then
            even = kind
            counts = arguments[0..arguments.count - 1]
        else
            return Parsed.REJECTED(
                "\"{trailing}\" is not lucky or evenLucky")
        fi
    fi

    if counts.count == 0 then
        return Parsed.REJECTED("no index given")
    fi

    if counts.count > 2 then
        return Parsed.REJECTED("expected at most two numbers")
    fi

    let bad = counts |> find(text => !as_number(text)?)

    if let wrong = bad then
        return Parsed.REJECTED("\"{wrong}\" is not a number")
    fi

    let first = as_number(counts[0])!

    if first < 1 then
        return Parsed.REJECTED("the first index must be at least one")
    fi

    if counts.count == 1 then
        return Parsed.UNDERSTOOD(Request.NTH(first, even))
    fi

    let second = as_number(counts[1])!

    if second < 0 then
        return Parsed.UNDERSTOOD(Request.BY_VALUE(first, -second, even))
    fi

    Parsed.UNDERSTOOD(Request.BY_INDEX(first, second, even))
si

evaluate(request: Request) -> List[int] =>
    case request
    when one: Request.NTH then
        [series(one.even)[one.index - 1]]
    when indexed: Request.BY_INDEX then
        series(indexed.even)
            |> skip(indexed.first - 1)
            |> take(indexed.last - indexed.first + 1)
            |> collect()
    when valued: Request.BY_VALUE then
        series(valued.even)
            |> filter(value => value >= valued.low /\ value <= valued.high)
            |> collect()
    esac

run(arguments: List[string]) is
    write_line("lucky {arguments |> join(" ")}".trim_end())

    let outcome = parse(arguments)

    if outcome? then
        write_line("  {evaluate(outcome.request) |> join(" ")}")
    else
        write_line("  error: {outcome.message}")
    fi
si

[["1", "20"], ["1", "20", "evenLucky"],
 ["6000", "-6100"], ["6000", "-6100", "EVENLUCKY"],
 ["10000"], ["10000", "evenlucky"],
 LIST[string](), ["1", "2", "3", "4"], ["fish"], ["1", "10", "unlucky"]]
    |> each(run)
